title: Supply filter shows an untracked part only under All
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Parts → Inventory is open on the Active tab at {Location-A}.
  • Bin {Bin-A} is the default bin of {Location-A} (for example General Storage), the bin New Inventory Part fills in.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SUPPLY-T1) is tracked at {Location-A}, holding 1 in {Bin-A} with Min 5 and Max 10, so it is below its Min.
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SUPPLY-U1) is untracked at {Location-A}, holding 1 in {Bin-A} with Min 5 and Max 10 saved while it was tracked.
  • Both part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-SUPPLY-), which is typed in the Inventory search.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Supply filter and choose Under-supplied.
  2. Read which of the two parts are listed.
  3. Change the Supply filter to Well-supplied.
  4. Read the list.
  5. Change the Supply filter to Over-supplied.
  6. Read the list.
  7. Change the Supply filter to All.
  8. Read the list.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: {Part-A} is listed (1 is below its Min of 5); {Part-B} is not listed, although it also holds 1 against a Min of 5.
  • Step 4: {Part-B} is not listed, and neither is {Part-A}.
  • Step 6: {Part-B} is not listed, and neither is {Part-A}.
  • Step 8: Both {Part-A} and {Part-B} are listed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10819 (Story 6, Search and Sort the Inventory List by Tracking State); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, as edited 9 Oct 2026 (Ready for dev), S6-R10 and §2 Out of scope (reorder changes beyond the Supply filter), read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.0 (the Supply filter in today's toolbar), 13 Oct copy. Product's answer of 9 Oct 2026, question 10: the option is "All", as the Supply filter says today. Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S6-R10: “In the Supply filter, an untracked part shows only under "All". Under-supplied, Well-supplied and Over-supplied leave it out.”
  • PRD §2 Out of scope: “Reorder and stockout alert changes, beyond leaving untracked parts out of the Supply filter (S6-R10).”
